title.ko: 학술적 헤징: It would seem · tends to · to some extent · there is some evidence · can be argued
title.en: scholarly hedging: it would seem, tends to, to some extent, there is some evidence, it can be argued

explain.ko: 학술 글쓰기는 증거의 강도에 맞게 주장을 조절하는 헤징(hedging)을 사용합니다. 동사 suggest, indicate, appear to를, 조동사 may, might, could를, 부사 possibly, arguably, to some extent를, 구문 It would seem that ..., It can be argued that ...을 씁니다. 헤징은 단정을 피하고 비판에 열려 있는 태도를 보이지만, 지나치면 주장이 약해지므로 근거와 균형을 맞추세요.
explain.en: Academic writing uses hedging to calibrate claims to the strength of evidence. Use verbs such as suggest, indicate and appear to; modals such as may, might and could; adverbs such as possibly, arguably and to some extent; and structures such as It would seem that ... and It can be argued that ... Hedging avoids certainty and shows openness to criticism, but excess weakens the claim, so balance it with the evidence.
